title: ConstantModelOpenProjection
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed coefficient ring [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients], and let $j:U\to X$ be an open immersion of Noetherian schemes. For arbitrary $L\in D(U,\Lambda)$ and $M\in D(X,\Lambda)$ there is an isomorphism $(j_!L)\otimes^{\mathbf L}M\simeq j_!(L\otimes^{\mathbf L}j^*M)$. The categories, tensor and exact extension by zero are [sk-def-sfb-derived-categories, sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom, sk-def-sfb-module-lower-shriek]. No boundedness or constructibility is assumed.

proof.text: Choose the complementary closed immersion and apply the open internal-Hom formula, including its naturality clause, to construct a natural isomorphism RHom_X(j!L,-) ~= Rj* RHom_U(L,j*(-)). Compose j! adjoint j*, the tensor-Hom adjunction for L, and j* adjoint Rj*. This makes the functor j!(L tensor j*(-)) a left adjoint of the displayed right adjoint. The tensor-Hom adjunction for j!L, transported through the natural isomorphism, gives the same right adjoint to (j!L) tensor (-). Uniqueness of left adjoints gives the desired natural isomorphism. Finally identify supportPullback with the specified upperStar using mapDerivedCategoryNatIso. All inputs are arbitrary unbounded derived objects.

theorem constantModel_open_projection
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ] {U X : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsNoetherian U] [IsNoetherian X] (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (L : DerivedCategory (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology U) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj Λ U)))
    (M : DerivedCategory (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj Λ X))) :
    Nonempty ((((derivedTensor Λ X).obj
      ((openImmersionLowerShriek Λ j).mapDerivedCategory.obj L)).obj M) ≅
      (openImmersionLowerShriek Λ j).mapDerivedCategory.obj
        (((derivedTensor Λ U).obj L).obj ((upperStar Λ j).mapDerivedCategory.obj M)))
